title: Her Name.
overview: Season 2 begins, and the gap between the seasons means the girlfriends are immediately faced with a crisis. Rentaro, meanwhile, happens to run into a very hungry girl...

title: The Beginning and the End! Food Fight Festival!
overview: The food fight festival is here, and the Rentaro Family moves out in order to win the special gelato for themselves. Will they be successful?

title: What Does the Maid See?
overview: Hakari laments the change in her once dignified mother. Meanwhile, Hahari's maid piques the gang's curiosity.

title: Super Soaked Maid Party
overview: Only one way to welcome a maid into the crew: everyone changes into maid outfits and has a shootout!

title: Most Athletes Are Masochists
overview: While the girlfriends are forced to work out, Rentaro runs into a girl who punishes herself for other reasons.

title: A Homerun Promise
overview: It's time for the big game. Will the Rentaro Family win and ensure the baseball team's survival?

title: Karaoke Crisis
overview: The gang goes to karaoke! But how will Shizuka manage?

title: The Beautiful and the Bold
overview: Mimimi and Nano face off in a Beauty Search contest to determine who'll be exiled from the Rentaro Family.

title: The World Hair Only Grows
overview: With Rentaro still shaved from the beauty search, the gang decide to show solidarity...to disastrous results.

title: Peekaboy-Meets-Girl
overview: Kakure Meme is an extremely shy girl who wishes to live life as a no-name background character. Will she succeed?

title: Tsundere Lost
overview: Karane becomes increasingly worried at her inability to be sincere and express her feelings. What will she do?

title: The 100 Girlfriends Who Really, Really, Really, Really, REALLY Love You (89 to Go)
overview: Rentaro has come up with a convoluted plan to get Karane's tsundere back. Will it work out?
